body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an ally within 4 units is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The target gains +1 Defense against the triggering Action. If the target is Possessed, increase this bonus by 1.

surges.html: One ally affected by this Reaction gains +1 Defense until its next turn.
If two creatures meet the Trigger simultaneously, apply this Reaction's non-damage effect to both.
